title: Windows: Switch from HTML Help to plain HTML.
description:
Switch from HTML Help to plain HTML files. In the NSIS and WiX installers,
place the help assets in a directory with a friendly name.

notes.body:
added 8 commits
  • 1c0348bc...256af1d2 - 7 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • a24afffb - Windows: Switch from HTML Help to plain HTML.
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/3213/diffs?diff_id=195430138&start_sha=1c0348bc712d9134398adeeb477cda7e6efda2a5)

added 3 commits
  • a24afffb...6846271b - 2 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • 6bfab69d - Windows: Switch from HTML Help to plain HTML.
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/3213/diffs?diff_id=195705519&start_sha=a24afffb28f3a7f58f605b4d147cad440edf3552)
The Win64 builder failed its last step of archiving the help files.
That's now done by the "Documentation" job in .gitlab-ci.yml, so I went ahead and removed the Buildbot step.
Two (2) empty links to "Windows HTML Help" on https://www.wireshark.org/docs/

As https://www.wireshark.org/lists/wireshark-dev/202107/msg00047.html notes, we no offer a .chm version of the User's Guide on the web site due to this change. An EPUB created using asciidoctor-epub3 is attached, which might make a suitable replacement.

[user-guide.epub](/uploads/f0bfc904fee41f35b3f8cc14b667b56c/user-guide.epub)

 http://xmlsoft.org/xslt/[xsltproc] converts DocBook XML to various formats based on XSL stylesheets.
 It either ships as part of the operating system or is available via an installable package on most Linux distributions, Chocolatey, and Homebrew.
 
-==== HTML Help
-
-HTML Help is used to create the User’s and Developer’s Guide in .chm format.
-The User’s Guide .chm file is included with the NSIS and WiX installers and
-is used as Wireshark's built-in help on Windows.
-
-This compiler is used to generate a .chm file from a bunch of HTML files -- in
-our case to generate the User’s and Developer’s Guide in .chm format.
-
-The compiler is only available as the free (as in beer) "HTML Help Workshop"
-download. If you want to compile the guides yourself, you need to download and
-install this. If you don't install it into the default directory, you may also
-have a look at the HHC_DIR setting in the file docbook/Makefile.
-
-The files `htmlhelp.c` and `htmlhelp.lib` are required to
-be able to open .chm files from Wireshark and show the
-online help. Both files are part of the SDK (standalone (P)SDK or MSVC
-since 2002).

Switch from HTML Help to plain HTML files. In the NSIS and WiX installers,
place the help assets in a directory with a friendly name.
